lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Open a project with direct SQLite vector layers, including old local_vector_tiles metadata and multi-megabyte original geometry payloads
Repeatedly pan and zoom across tile boundaries, rotate the device, background/restore the map and trigger several style reloads for at least ten minutes
Run a synchronization while continuing to move the map and inspect heap plus HyperLog
value.expected: The app stays responsive and alive with complete visible IDs, labels and styles after pan/zoom/recreate. Shared native admission is bounded, obsolete provider generations reject late delivery and resource pressure never produces partial successful PBF. No loopback socket/server is opened. Native resource/performance acceptance remains separate from compile/JVM.
